title: Coordinate bound for low degree mass
statement: Let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube to $\{-1,1\}$, let $\tau\in\mathbb R$, and let $k\in\mathbb N$. The sum of the squared Fourier coefficients over sets $S$ with $|S|\le k$ that are not contained in the coordinates whose influence is at least $\tau$ is at most the sum, over all coordinates whose influence is less than $\tau$, of the squared Fourier coefficients over sets $S$ with $|S|\le k$ that contain that coordinate.
